limits.validation: CRC, demux status, DVB SDT/PMT/EIT descriptor bounds; not a complete conformance checker
limits.native_json: XML element names and values preserved; attribute keys use ASCII lowercase for API compatibility. Rare case collisions preserve all original attributes in xml_attributes and identify collisions. tsduck_xml retains SDK XML spelling.
limits.native_decoding: TSDuck registered tables/descriptors with complete-table assembly and explicit signalling standards context; raw fallback for unknown/unsupported structures. TS files only, DTMB context includes registered DTMB signalling descriptors only; no RF demodulation or blanket standards-conformance claim.
limits.j94_system_b: Explicit ITU-T J.94 (10/2016) System B section inspection; descriptor-revised NIT/NTT/short-VCT subtables via bounded query_cable_oob, plus STT arithmetic. Raw short headers stay unversioned. No current SCTE65 equivalence, synchronized network lineup, receiver actions, OOB hardware or snapshot export.
limits.snapshot_comparison: Read-only selected valid-current section, actual-TS service and EIT observation differences within one successful analysis revision. Maximum 200 changes per page. Not broadcast validity or EIT schedule completeness.
limits.cancellation: Cooperative targeted cancellation of queued or running analyses. Integer/string request IDs are distinct. Accepted cancellation wins over completion until the terminal commit. Blocking file reads, SDK work and stdout may delay cancellation.
limits.responsive_analysis: Opt-in compact progress/terminal metadata, lazy revision/cutoff-bound collection pages, bounded occurrence inspection, and cooperative pause/resume. Legacy result shapes remain default.
limits.partial_analysis: Prefix, explicit packet range or a few distributed contiguous windows. Packet positions remain source-absolute. Gaps reset section assembly and semantic generation selection. Partial evidence cannot be edited or exported.

tools.name: import_dvbi
tools.description: Import a bounded local regular UTF-8 DVB-I XML file, without network access. Transactionally replaces only the independent metadata document after parsing succeeds; leaves TS state and old document intact on failure. No asynchronous cancellation.

tools.name: query_dvbi
tools.description: Read a page of service-list, service, instance and LCN metadata. Unsupported XML namespaces remain raw-only. Exact declared identities and source locators; no inferred media reception or TS association.

tools.name: inspect_dvbi
tools.description: Inspect one namespace-expanded XML element at an exact document revision and a bounded page of authoritative original file bytes encoded as hex. Text is XML-normalized UTF-8, never a substitute for original bytes. No PID, CRC or packet positions.

tools.name: lookup_satellite
tools.description: Read-only candidate GEO satellite lookup in an incomplete local reference catalog. Orbital position only; no confirmed identity or transponder validation. Raw query and catalog provenance retained. No scan required.

tolerance_degrees.description: Explicit orbital-position tolerance; default 0 means identical nominal slot.

tools.name: lookup_identifier
tools.description: Resolve a typed identifier using the installed SDK registry. Reference label only, not verified current ownership. No scan required.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Discover tool schemas and implementation limits.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Incrementally scan a local TS file; keep section evidence and version occurrences in this session. Emits progress notifications.

default_charset.description: Optional SDK input charset. DVB charsets honor explicit wire selectors; RAW charsets do not. Interpretation only, original bytes preserved.

standards.description: Signalling interpretation context. auto may be ambiguous; select the known broadcast family. Does not configure RF demodulation.

max_packets.description: Total packet budget for prefix/distributed, default 250000; full ignores this field.

end_packet.description: Exclusive source-absolute end packet for range mode.

window_count.description: Number of sequential windows for distributed mode, default 4; adjacent windows are merged.

sample_percent.description: For prefix/distributed only: total budget=max(1,floor(source_packets*percent/100)), after framing detection. Mutually exclusive with max_packets. Rejected for full/range.

tools.name: cancel_analysis
tools.description: Request cancellation of the queued/running analyze with exactly this integer or string JSONL request ID. Bypasses the ordinary FIFO. Returns requested=true when accepted (including repeated requests), otherwise requested=false/reason=not_running. Original analyze terminates once with analysis_cancelled and error.data.state: cleared evidence, analysis_status=cancelled, complete=false, retained source/processed packets. Other methods are not cancelled.

request_id.description: Original analyze request ID. Integer 1 and string "1" identify different requests.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Read retained section evidence (including invalid raw variants), per-version coverage, packet-arrival distributions and latest observed current sections and derived actual-TS services from complete SDT on canonical PID 0x0011 (extra-PID SDTs stay table evidence) at a packet position. Observation state, not a guarantee of broadcast validity intervals. Opt-in response_mode compact returns only metadata; hydrate requested collections with query_result.

tools.name: query_topology
tools.description: Read-only evidence-linked semantic graph from complete valid-current generations in one successful analysis. Explicit DVB, ATSC or ISDB analysis profile; auto remains unresolved. Deterministic parent-before-child pages; parent_id limits immediate children (empty string means roots). View family never changes interpretation. No RF/media validation. Stale revision and out-of-range cutoff rejected.

tools.name: diff_snapshots
tools.description: Compare two inclusive packet-cutoff observation snapshots in the current successful analysis. Read-only deterministic added/removed/changed table section slots, actual-TS services from canonical SDT PID 0x0011 and DVB-layout EIT (0x4e..0x6f) event evidence; repeats and provenance-only updates do not count as content changes. Both cutoffs must be within 0..packets-1; reverse and equal cutoffs are allowed. Pages are filtered by kind; summary counts always cover all kinds. Keep revision and cutoffs fixed while paginating. Event identities retain PID/table/section/network/service/id/start; rescheduling or moving section is removed+added.

from_packet.description: Inclusive baseline section completion packet index.

to_packet.description: Inclusive comparison section completion packet index.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Get raw bytes, descriptor fields, errors and exact packet occurrences of one stable section ID.

analysis_revision.description: Optional same-analysis evidence guard; stale revisions are rejected.

at_packet.description: Limit section occurrences and native table assembly to observations at or before this packet. Rejects sections not yet observed. Omitted: all occurrences; native table assembled at inspected section last occurrence.

tools.name: load_extension
tools.description: Load declarative PDS/table-scoped private descriptor definitions and service sorting rules. Rescan required. Does not execute scripts.

tools.name: preview_rename
tools.description: Preview a service-name edit to a complete single-section actual SDT; TSDuck serializes it and updates version/CRC. Names are limited to 1..180 UTF-8 bytes (multibyte characters use more than one byte). Returns a token bound to this analysis revision.

name.description: 1..180 UTF-8 bytes; for example, at most 60 three-byte Chinese characters.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Write a new signalling-only TS (with null padding) or concatenated section BIN plus PID/provenance manifest. Never overwrite existing output. No media, PCR or original pacing. Optional preview token applies an edit to the selected snapshot.

tools.name: query_cable_oob
tools.description: Read edition-pinned J.94 descriptor-revised subtables at an exact analysis revision and packet cutoff. Absent/ambiguous revision metadata is not assembled; conflicts and missing ranges remain evidence. No complete network lineup or receiver activation. Continuation pages require explicit analysis_revision and at_packet.

tools.name: pause_analysis
tools.description: Cooperatively pause a matching queued/running analysis; acknowledgement is not the owner-thread paused progress event.

request_id.description: Original analyze request ID. Integer 1 and string "1" identify different requests.

tools.name: resume_analysis
tools.description: Cooperatively resume a matching queued/running analysis; acknowledgement is not the owner-thread paused progress event.

request_id.description: Original analyze request ID. Integer 1 and string "1" identify different requests.

tools.name: query_result
tools.description: Read a revision/cutoff-bound, lazy cached result collection page. Tables/groups omit distributions; inspect one section for distribution. History/density remain scan-global. Maximum 256 KiB item payload per page.

tools.name: query_transport
tools.description: Read bounded per-PID transport counters for all observed scan windows. Scan-global even when an inspector has a historical cutoff. Rates/duration use only supplied normalized 188-byte TS bitrate; no PCR clock measurement. Error packets exclude continuity, CRC, PES and decoder errors.

tools.name: query_packet
tools.description: Read actual source TS packet and framing bytes with bounded PID search. Packet indexes are zero based. No reconstructed packets; unmatched batch returns a continuation index. Source must remain unchanged.

tools.name: query_timing
tools.description: Read bounded raw PCR observations and measured normalized TS bitrate. Wrap-aware consecutive intervals only; excludes gaps, discontinuities and intervals over ten seconds. Not a complete timing/conformance checker.
